channels.description: RadioFoundry UI · DMR, FM and conventional P25

releases.notes: Classic r13 fixes the r12 P25 transmit-startup timer collision and completes P25 RX/TX hardware ownership release after delayed cleanup. It retains the r12 speaker FIFO fix and the existing MIT IMBE codec and gain. This public line remains FM, DMR and conventional P25. Existing RFKV programming, RX-only defaults, transmit checks and reserved codec slot are preserved. Full host and sanitizer tests, target stack/ABI checks, zero-warning builds and a byte-identical forced rebuild passed. The matching fix candidate passed installation/startup and saved-channel checks; manual on-air PTT/audio qualification remains pending. A DMR-only endurance lockout has not been reproduced. Known issue: PL/CTCSS can drop during DTMF.
